quiz.where: Final test, why-shared-words, option d feedback: "The agent has no memory between sessions." (line 455)
quiz.problem: The feedback states something false about Claude Code. Claude Code has auto memory, which is on by default and loaded at the start of every session. Two earlier Lessons teach exactly that, so this line also contradicts them.
quiz.evidence: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory says two mechanisms carry knowledge across sessions, CLAUDE.md files and auto memory, and that auto memory is on by default in local sessions and loaded into every session. content/lessons/01-how-agents-work.md:40 says the next session remembers nothing "unless something was written to a file, by you or by Claude Code in notes it keeps for itself". 01-how-agents-work.md:198 introduces auto memory. content/lessons/02-context-window.md:38 lists it as "auto memory, on by default". This Lesson's own body (line 22) gets it right: gone "unless it's in a file the agent reads".
quiz.fix: Replace line 455 with: `  > Only files carry anything from one session to the next, and the glossary holds words, not past conversations.`
